name: Bulwark
summary: Bulwark; While using a shield, allies behind you gain light cover.  Bulwark; While using a shield, you also gain advantage on saves against being shoved. descriptionMarkdown:
Bulwark; While using a shield, allies behind you gain light cover.

Bulwark; While using a shield, you also gain advantage on saves against being shoved.

Bulwark; Allies benefiting from cover provided by your slab shield have advantage on Dexterity saving throws against Blast and Spray effects, and ignore the first 5 ft of forced movement they would suffer each round.

Bulwark; While using a slab shield, adjacent allies also gain resistance to damage from opportunity attacks.
